evals.prompt: Create a durable project knowledge layer for coding agents in the fixture repository at evals/files/create-core. Use the repository evidence to map what the project enables and how it works. Keep the result compact.
evals.expected_output: A new docs/project-knowledge knowledge layer with README.md, CONTEXT.md, and ARCHITECTURE.md. README.md links directly to both curated pages, CONTEXT.md contains an evidence-backed project functionality view spanning HTTP, scheduled work, and event consumption, and ARCHITECTURE.md maps each registered flow without changing product files.
assertions: docs/project-knowledge/README.md, CONTEXT.md, and ARCHITECTURE.md are created with exact case-sensitive names
The knowledge README links directly to CONTEXT.md and ARCHITECTURE.md

CONTEXT.md presents a project-level functionality view that covers the registered POST /orders request, hourly expiration job, and payment.captured consumer, including their actors or system triggers, observable outcomes, state effects, implementation, focused tests, and evidenced failure behavior or an explicit verification gap where relevant
ARCHITECTURE.md traces the HTTP route, scheduled-job registry, and event-consumer registry to their effective handlers and distinguishes returned results from internal state changes
CONTEXT.md and ARCHITECTURE.md use valid source-linked metadata
Every listed product fixture file remains byte-for-byte unchanged
No empty placeholder page or directory is created

evals.prompt: Refresh the existing project knowledge in evals/files/maintain-minimal after the export row limit changed in source. Keep the result evidence-backed and scoped to that change.
evals.expected_output: Only the owning export topic page changes from the stale 500-row limit to the evidenced 1000-row limit. The human-maintained column-order note and the root README, CONTEXT.md, and ARCHITECTURE.md remain byte-for-byte unchanged, and the exact limit is not copied into other pages.
assertions: Among repository files, only docs/project-knowledge/features/exports.md is modified
The export owner page changes the stale maximum from 500 rows to the source-backed 1000 rows
The sentence beginning Human-maintained note remains byte-for-byte unchanged
The exact row-limit fact remains owned by features/exports.md and is not duplicated into README.md, CONTEXT.md, or ARCHITECTURE.md
The completion report identifies the evidence and confirms the unchanged knowledge files

evals.prompt: Audit the existing project knowledge in evals/files/audit-layered-dispatch against current repository evidence. This is report-only: do not edit any file. Trace each claimed socket command through every dispatch stage and distinguish supported behavior from unreachable or no-op behavior.
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit report that confirms sync is supported, reports archive as unreachable despite its handler, and reports preview as a reachable no-op that does not produce the documented preview. Each finding names the listener, allowlist, command map, handler, test evidence, consequence, and focused repair.
assertions: No fixture file is modified
The report does not treat the existence of archiveWorkspace as proof of support and explains that archive is absent from both the external allowlist and command map
The report traces preview through the listener and command map to previewWorkspace, then identifies that the handler has no effective action or documented result
The report distinguishes the fully reachable and effective sync command from the two contradicted capability claims
Every finding includes repository evidence, consequence for coding agents, and a focused proposed repair without applying it

evals.prompt: Refresh the existing project knowledge in evals/files/repeat-unchanged. Repository evidence has not changed since the knowledge was reviewed. Verify the content and report the result.
evals.expected_output: No repository content changes. The completion report states that the current knowledge remains supported, records the checks performed, and does not add dates, freshness labels, or commit metadata solely because maintenance was requested.
assertions: Every fixture file remains byte-for-byte unchanged
No timestamp, freshness label, verified_commit value, or cosmetic reformatting is added
The report confirms that README.md still links the two required curated pages and that their claims match source and focused tests
The report lists deterministic and semantic checks and explicitly states that no knowledge content change was needed
